subject: Fix rdmaServer leaks when create listen cm id error (#3557)
reason: The change only fixes a resource leak (event channel and addrinfo not freed) on an error path in rdmaServer when rdma_create_id fails during RDMA listener setup. It has no observable behaviour change: the listen attempt fails with the same error either way. Reaching the path requires an RDMA-enabled build, RDMA hardware or soft-RoCE (root), and an induced rdma_create_id failure at server startup — none of which the fuzzer's local throwaway servers can provide, and no installed or composable experiment exercises RDMA transport. No scenario can reach the changed code.
